name: print-social-orange-gradient-qr-ticket-notice-with-phone-mockup
title: Orange QR Ticket Notice with Phone
whatItIs: A vivid orange gradient post with a large white centred message 'Heads up! QR codes won't be emailed anymore.' and a lighter line 'Your tickets live in Orbit now.', above a phone in a darker red-orange frame showing a ticket with a large QR code and a green VALID tag.
whatItMeans: A full-bleed orange gives the notice urgency, and showing the ticket screen tells users where to look.
techniques: Two-tier white headline with different weights
Phone cropped by the bottom edge
Tonal frame around the phone in a darker orange
Small green status tag inside the UI
bestFor: Urgent notices with a product visual

vocabulary.definition: A frame in a darker shade of the background colour.
A small label such as VALID showing a state.
A post announcing a change users need to know.
